title: Omit empty duplicate displays from the Display panel
author: vincentritter
body: The Display panel lists every connector Hyprland reports. On a dual-GPU laptop that includes outputs that cannot show a picture. The GPU that is not wired to the panel still exposes an eDP. Hyprland's catch-all `preferred` rule enables it at 0×0, with no EDID, no modes, and no make or model. The panel then draws a second row, checked as if it were a real screen. It is not the Touch Bar. Omarchy already treats an enabled 0×0 output as sick: `omarchy-hyprland-monitor-modeless` reloads until a mode appears. That recovery is for a monitor that powered on with a partial EDID. A permanent ghost never gets a mode, so reload cannot help, and the list stays wrong even after the connector is disabled by hand. #10198 disables those ghosts in Hyprland. This pull request filters the list. `omarchy-monitor-state` omits a connector that has no geometry, no modes, and no identity. A clamshelled laptop panel is also 0×0, but it still has EDID and modes, so it stays in the list and can be turned back on. A real HDMI you turned off is kept for the same reason. DRM names for these connectors swap across boots, so this does not key off `eDP-1` versus `eDP-2`. Hardcoding a port name would disable the laptop panel on the next numbering. `parseDisplays` also drops an enabled 0×0, so a live ghost cannot count as a second screen or let you disable the last real output. ### Before The stock Display panel on a T2 MacBook Pro (Intel + AMD). In this capture `eDP-2` is the laptop panel and `eDP-1` is the AMD eDP: connected, empty identity, no modes. ### After The same session, ghost still enabled in Hyprland. The panel no longer offers the empty connector, and the DISPLAYS section goes away because only one real screen remains. ### Tests `test/shell.d/monitor-state-test.sh` and `test/shell.d/monitor-test.sh` cover an enabled ghost, a disabled ghost, either eDP numbering, a clamshelled internal that must still list, and a user-disabled HDMI that must still list.

files.patch:
@@ -19,5 +19,13 @@ printf '%s\n' "$monitors_json" | jq -r '
 printf '%s\n' "$focused_monitor"
 omarchy-hyprland-monitor-scaling 2>/dev/null || echo
 
-printf '%s\n' "$monitors_json" | jq -c \
-  '[.[] | {name, enabled:(.disabled != true), focused:(.focused == true), width, height}]'
+printf '%s\n' "$monitors_json" | jq -c '
+  def present: . != null and . != "";
+  def listable:
+    ((.width // 0) > 0 and (.height // 0) > 0)
+    or ((.availableModes // []) | length) > 0
+    or (.description | present)
+    or (.make | present)
+    or (.model | present);
+  [.[] | select(listable) | {name, enabled:(.disabled != true), focused:(.focused == true), width, height}]
+'

@@ -75,8 +75,23 @@ reverse_mirrored='[
 ]'
 
 clamshell='[
-  { "name": "eDP-1", "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": true, "focused": false, "width": 0, "height": 0 },
-  { "name": "DP-1", "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": true, "width": 2560, "height": 1440 }
+  { "name": "eDP-1", "description": "AU Optronics 0x1234", "make": "AU Optronics", "model": "0x1234", "availableModes": ["1920x1080@60.00Hz"], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": true, "focused": false, "width": 0, "height": 0 },
+  { "name": "DP-1", "description": "Dell Inc. DELL U2720Q", "make": "Dell Inc.", "model": "DELL U2720Q", "availableModes": ["2560x1440@60.00Hz"], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": true, "width": 2560, "height": 1440 }
+]'
+
+ghost='[
+  { "name": "eDP-1", "description": "", "make": "", "model": "", "availableModes": [], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": false, "width": 0, "height": 0 },
+  { "name": "eDP-2", "description": "Apple Computer Inc Color LCD", "make": "Apple Computer Inc", "model": "Color LCD", "availableModes": ["2880x1800@60.00Hz"], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": true, "width": 2880, "height": 1800 }
+]'
+
+disabled_ghost='[
+  { "name": "eDP-1", "description": "", "make": "", "model": "", "availableModes": [], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": true, "focused": false, "width": 0, "height": 0 },
+  { "name": "eDP-2", "description": "Apple Computer Inc Color LCD", "make": "Apple Computer Inc", "model": "Color LCD", "availableModes": ["2880x1800@60.00Hz"], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": true, "width": 2880, "height": 1800 }
+]'
+
+swapped_ghost='[
+  { "name": "eDP-1", "description": "Apple Computer Inc Color LCD", "make": "Apple Computer Inc", "model": "Color LCD", "availableModes": ["2880x1800@60.00Hz"], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": true, "width": 2880, "height": 1800 },
+  { "name": "eDP-2", "description": "", "make": "", "model": "", "availableModes": [], "mirrorOf": "none", "disabled": false, "focused": false, "width": 0, "height": 0 }
 ]'
 
 monitor_state "$extended"
@@ -115,3 +130,21 @@ monitor_state "$clamshell"
 [[ ${state_lines[7]-} == '[{"name":"eDP-1","enabled":false,"focused":false,"width":0,"height":0},{"name":"DP-1","enabled":true,"focused":true,"width":2560,"height":1440}]' ]] ||
   fail "monitor state lists every display for the panel" "actual: ${state_lines[7]-<missing>}"
 pass "monitor state lists every display with its enabled and focused state"
+
+monitor_state "$ghost"
+assert_line_count "monitor state answers every line with a ghost internal connector"
+[[ ${state_lines[7]-} == '[{"name":"eDP-2","enabled":true,"focused":true,"width":2880,"height":1800}]' ]] ||
+  fail "monitor state omits an empty duplicate internal connector" "actual: ${state_lines[7]-<missing>}"
+pass "monitor state omits an empty duplicate internal connector"
+
+monitor_state "$disabled_ghost"
+assert_line_count "monitor state answers every line with a disabled ghost connector"
+[[ ${state_lines[7]-} == '[{"name":"eDP-2","enabled":true,"focused":true,"width":2880,"height":1800}]' ]] ||
+  fail "monitor state omits a disabled empty internal connector" "actual: ${state_lines[7]-<missing>}"
+pass "monitor state omits a disabled empty internal connector"
+
+monitor_state "$swapped_ghost"
+assert_line_count "monitor state answers every line when the ghost is eDP-2"
+[[ ${state_lines[7]-} == '[{"name":"eDP-1","enabled":true,"focused":true,"width":2880,"height":1800}]' ]] ||
+  fail "monitor state omits an empty duplicate regardless of eDP numbering" "actual: ${state_lines[7]-<missing>}"
+pass "monitor state omits an empty duplicate regardless of eDP numbering"

@@ -74,5 +74,19 @@ assertDeepEqual(
   'monitor parses display state'
 )
 
+assertDeepEqual(
+  monitor.parseDisplays(JSON.stringify([
+    { name: 'eDP-2', enabled: true, focused: true, width: 2880, height: 1800 },
+    { name: 'eDP-1', enabled: true, focused: false, width: 0, height: 0 }
+  ])),
+  {
+    displays: [
+      { name: 'eDP-2', enabled: true, focused: true, width: 2880, height: 1800 }
+    ],
+    enabledDisplayCount: 1
+  },
+  'monitor omits an enabled output with no mode'
+)
+
 assertDeepEqual(monitor.parseDisplays('{'), { displays: [], enabledDisplayCount: 0 }, 'monitor handles invalid display JSON')
